name: Maury's Clubbed Foot
summary: Maury “Club Foot” Wilkins carries one of the debts Sea Wolf MacKinley means to collect in Booty Bay. His clubbed foot holds something MacKinley believes is valuable.

sections.title: A Debt in the Jungle
sections.body: Among the debtors MacKinley names, Maury “Club Foot” Wilkins wanders the jungle ruins with Jon-Jon the Crow and Chucky “Ten Thumbs.” Their debts have gone unpaid for months, and MacKinley sends you to find them at the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal. Maury’s clubbed foot is among the valuables he wants returned to Booty Bay.

sections.title: MacKinley’s Price
sections.body: When you bring the three valuables back, MacKinley says he can get a good price for them. He speaks of what is inside Maury’s foot, then warns that the three should have been careful who they gambled with.

faq.answer: Maury “Club Foot” Wilkins is a debtor of Sea Wolf MacKinley who wanders the jungle ruins.

faq.q: Why does MacKinley want Maury’s foot?
faq.answer: MacKinley wants Maury’s Clubbed Foot among the valuables he collects from the debtors.
MacKinley says there is something inside Maury’s foot that he can sell for a good price.
Maury wanders the jungle ruins near the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal.
Jon-Jon the Crow and Chucky “Ten Thumbs” are also among MacKinley’s debtors.
